mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rises above 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% and decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 index points signals a deepening economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE > 8.0% and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (defined by quarterly GDP growth above 2% and rising interest rates), a further increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 2% q/q), FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.10pp but SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900,000 units per month signals weakening demand for residential construction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where HOUST falls below 900.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 400,000 million dollars and falling industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 index points signals a broad-based economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where RSAFS < 400,000 and INDPRO < 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL above 3.0% year-over-year), a further rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y), FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.10pp but SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of such instances.
